mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, buyer.username AS buyerName, buyer.address AS buyerAddress, o.seller_id AS sellerId, seller.username AS sellerName, seller.address AS sellerAddress, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status, o.created_at AS createdAt FROM orders o LEFT JOIN users buyer ON o.buyer_id = buyer.user_id LEFT JOIN users seller ON o.seller_id = seller.user_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, oi.order_id AS orderId, oi.item_id AS itemId, i.title AS itemTitle, oi.price, oi.quantity FROM order_items oi LEFT JOIN items i ON oi.item_id = i.item_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( buyer_id, seller_id, total_amount, status ) VALUES ( #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status} )

mapper.update:

buyer_id = #{buyerId},

mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId, r.rating, r.comment, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.item_id AS itemId FROM reviews r JOIN order_items oi ON r.item_id = oi.item_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
